Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

How is the tour actually customized?+
Before your trip, tell me what excites you — food, history, hidden spots, photography, or a mix. I design your route around that in advance, so it's ready before we meet.
What languages do you guide in?+
English, with Japanese as needed for translation along the way.
How many people can join?+
Tours are priced as a flat group rate for up to 4 people. Groups of 5–8 are welcome for +$30 per additional guest — just mention your group size when you reach out. For 9 or more, message me for a custom quote.
What's your cancellation policy?+
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before your tour. Message me as early as possible if your plans change and I'll do my best to work with you.
How do I pay?+
Once your date and plan are confirmed, I'll send a secure PayPal payment link to lock in your booking. No payment is needed before that.
What's the best way to reach you?+
Instagram DM is fastest — usually a reply within a few hours. You can also use the contact form in the booking section if you'd rather not use Instagram.
